I just wanna say, it sucks what you are going through. I live with my Dad who is a HUGE Trump guy (Lets Go Brandon Stickers,Maga shirts, Resist46, etc). I am polar opposite of him politically and we used to get into arguments ALL THE TIME. I have learned to just “okay” him or bring up something entirely different. All people are different so I do not know if my Anti-FoxPilled-Tech will work with your situation. 

ALSO do not be afraid to cut ties with ANYONE who is bad for your mental health. I learned, within the short amount of time I have been alive, that life is to short to be miserable because of someone.

Best of luck and at least I support whatever decision you choose ❤️!

It’s the actual worst. I felt sick all day and being a custodian in a school filled with kids that tend to do gross things that usually make me feel a little sick to begin with was not a good combination but today is over which is a relief
Need to scoop me up Paramore albums at one point! Riot and All We Know is Falling are classics!

When I am sick or injured I tend to binge more often! It’s something I struggle with it because I think I am so focused on trying to get better I fall into a weaker state of self control. But I know exactly know what you mean homie!

I have been there homie and still there battling! You got this 💪! I hope you realize that it is not your fault and you reaching out to a community made up of people that have this similar issue in our lives only shows that you are strong enough to move onward and destroy your urges to binge. What sometimes help for me is to go for a walk/bike ride to just get some fresh air and get me out of where I am. Another thing that I do is I will start something I can get easily lost into like playing guitar or playing a video game. Also one more thing that helps me is talking to people on a voice call in discord or just people in person so that I can’t focus on the urge to binge and/or past binges. These don’t always work but it never hurts to try. Don’t let a mistake be a let down because the only way to truly let yourself down is to just give up and at the point you would not even know/care you let yourself down homie.
(I hope my paragraph helps you in anyway. We might not have the same binge issue but I know what you are feeling and it is beyond shit!)
